projectInfo.title: Road Safety Mapping Around Schools
projectInfo.course: University of Mumbai B.Sc. Computer Science Semester V
projectInfo.status: Demo Data - Replace with Actual Field Data

school.name: St. Jude Model High School
school.address: Swami Vivekananda Road, Vile Parle (W), Mumbai, Maharashtra 400056

riskLocations.name: School Main Gate & Pedestrian Entry Plaza
riskLocations.problem: Chaotic double-parking of private cars and auto-rickshaws blocking entry gates; absence of speed tables or rumble strips.
riskLocations.observation: During afternoon dispersal (01:15 PM - 02:00 PM), over 45 vehicles simultaneously stop directly in front of the gate. Students are forced to weave between idling cars and moving motorcycles.
riskLocations.photoCaption: Main gate bottleneck showing vehicle accumulation and pedestrian swarming during dispersal.
riskLocations.recommendation: Construct a designated 50-meter passenger drop-off bay, install a raised tabletop zebra crossing with high-visibility thermoplastic markings, and post student safety traffic wardens.

riskLocations.name: SV Road & School Lane T-Junction
riskLocations.problem: High-speed auto-rickshaws and two-wheelers taking sharp blind turns into the school approach lane without slowing down; missing pedestrian signal phase.
riskLocations.observation: Speed radar spot-check observed vehicles approaching the turn at 42-48 km/h despite being in a designated school precinct. Crossing wait time for young children exceeds 3 minutes.
riskLocations.photoCaption: Intersection approach showing zero road signage and blind curvature into the school access street.
riskLocations.recommendation: Install solar-powered blinking amber warning beacons, road rumble strips 30m prior to junction, a convex safety mirror at the blind corner, and a pelican pedestrian signal with push-button activation.

riskLocations.name: North Perimeter Footpath & BEST Bus Shelter
riskLocations.problem: Broken pedestrian pavement slabs, commercial debris, and vendor encroachment forcing children to walk along the active carriage-way.
riskLocations.observation: Footpath width is reduced from 2.0 meters to less than 0.6 meters due to utility covers and temporary hawker stalls. 78% of observed students walked on the vehicular road.
riskLocations.photoCaption: Students walking on the road margin due to obstructed and broken footpath pavers.
riskLocations.recommendation: Relocate hawkers beyond the 100-meter school buffer zone, repair broken paver blocks, install pedestrian guardrails to separate sidewalk from moving vehicles.

riskLocations.name: West Residential Lane Intersection
riskLocations.problem: Zero school-zone regulatory signage; overgrown tree foliage blocks street lighting and obscures approaching student pedestrians.
riskLocations.observation: Vehicles entering from the residential bypass road are unaware of school proximity. At dusk and overcast mornings, ambient lux levels drop below standard roadway thresholds.
riskLocations.photoCaption: Tree canopy obscuring street light illumination and sightlines for drivers turning east.
riskLocations.recommendation: Erect retro-reflective fluorescent yellow-green 'School Zone Ahead - 25 km/h' signs, trim overhanging branches, and upgrade lighting to 40W LED luminaires.

riskLocations.name: South Pedestrian & Cycle Approach Crossing
riskLocations.problem: Zebra crossing markings are severely weathered and faded; no tactile pavers for visually impaired pedestrians.
riskLocations.observation: A zebra crossing exists on paper, but paint has eroded over 60% due to heavy monsoonal runoff. Drivers do not yield to crossing students because markings are barely visible at 20 meters.
riskLocations.photoCaption: Faded zebra crossing where white stripes have worn down to asphalt base.
riskLocations.recommendation: Repaint with high-durability thermoplastic reflective paint, install yellow tactile warning studs on kerb ramps, and place reflective bollards.

riskLocations.name: Rear Service & Kindergarten Wing Gate
riskLocations.problem: Garbage disposal trucks and canteen supplier vans reversing into the service alley concurrently with junior kindergarten dismissal.
riskLocations.observation: Reversing delivery truck had extensive blind spots with no audible reverse beeper or spotter guide while parents and small children (ages 4-6) were walking along the narrow gate.
riskLocations.photoCaption: Commercial service vehicle parked across kindergarten entry passage during student departure.
riskLocations.recommendation: Restrict all commercial deliveries and municipal waste collection to non-school hours (strictly before 07:00 AM or after 03:00 PM) with gate barrier protocols.
